title: Multiline input: arrow keys should navigate lines, not history
body: Codex CLI supports up/down navigation within multiline input. Claude Code does not. When editing a multi-line message, pressing up/down arrows jumps to command history instead of moving between lines, making it hard to edit longer messages.
author: showsf

top_comments.author: adamjgmiller
top_comments.body:
Confirming — but flagging that this is a **regression**, not a missing feature.

Up/down line navigation was working in my multiline prompts until ~2 days ago (broken since ~2026-05-26 for me, Linux). Worth noting it's broken-and-been-fixed before too: comments on the now-closed #20328 pinpoint v2.1.19 as the version it broke in back in January (last working v2.1.14). So this code path appears to regress periodically.

Suggest labeling `bug` and bisecting against the last 2-3 releases.

top_comments.author: artisticmedic
top_comments.body:
+1 on macOS — Claude Code 2.1.153, Darwin 25.5.0, cmux terminal. Broke this past week for me too.

Additional finding worth noting for triage: unbinding `up`/`down` in the `Chat` context via `~/.claude/keybindings.json` (setting both to `null`) does **not** restore visual-row navigation across soft-wrapped lines. Hard newlines (`Shift+Enter`) navigate fine; soft-wrapped logical lines do not. So the fall-through behavior of the input widget itself treats a wrapped line as a single logical line —

top_comments.author: scalebloom
top_comments.body:
FYI this is actually a **regression**, not a missing feature — multi-line cursor navigation worked correctly in 2.1.148 and broke in 2.1.149+. See #62736 (canonical) and #63191 (Windows bisect).

Probably worth retagging this from `enhancement` to `bug`/`regression` so it lands on the right triage queue.
